Best so far
Dec 2017 • Couples
As a man who likes his curries it has been a challenge to find a decent curry house in HCMC. Perhaps part of the issue is I am searching for the UK interpretation of the dishes. Mr Singh’s is the best so far in my opinion. Better than the two “G’s” anyway. Don’t expect a luxurious interior. It’s functional (but clean and comfortable) and the beer is cold if only bottled and of the usual varieties. We had chicken tikka , chicken vindaloo and sag aloo. All three were tasty with good spice level as requested. Portions weren’t huge but filling enough and the prices are reasonable. Still searching for one to rival Brick Lan’s finest but this won’t disappoint! 8/10!
